{{Current events|year=2019|month=01|day=18|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A massive explosion targetting a [[Tahrir al-Sham]] base in [[Idlib]] kills 15 people and wounds 20 others. A [[car bomb]] is reported to have been used in the attack. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-massive-explosion-rocks-idlib-city-15-killed/ (AMN)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[Myanmar]]'s [[Tatmadaw|military]] announces that it has killed 13 [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] fighters in a series of eight armed clashes in [[Rakhine State]], spanning from January 5 to 13. In the same press conference, a military spokesman states that the Arakan Army had been newly classified as a [[Terrorism in Myanmar|terrorist organization]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/myanmar-army-ordered-offensive-arakan-army-60466689 (ABC News)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/spokesman-myanmar-army-kills-13-rebels-in-rakhine-clashes/4748955.html (Reuters via VOA)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al Shabaab]] claims they killed over 57 [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian troops]] in an [[ambush]] in [[Somalia]]. [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian troops]] rejects that claim. [https://ent.siteintelgroup.com/Statements/shabaab-declares-ambush-killing-57-ethiopian-soldiers-a-severe-blow-and-stern-warning.html (SITE)] [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2019/01/19/ethiopia-readies-massive-offensive-on-al-shabab-in-somalia.html (''Toronto Star'')]
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**Unknown gunmen shoot dead two [[Buddhism|Buddhist]] [[Monks|monks]] and injure two others in an attack at a [[Temple|temple]] in [[Thailand|Thailand’s]] mainly [[Muslims|Muslim]] south. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-south/gunmen-kill-two-buddhist-monks-in-thailands-troubled-south-idUSKCN1PC26B (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian armed conflict]]
**[[Colombia]]n President [[Iván Duque Márquez]] unilaterally blames the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] for the [[2019 Bogotá car bombing]], and suspends ongoing peace talks with the group, requesting that the [[Cuba]]n government arrest the ten guerrilla group members leading the negotiations in [[Havana]]. [https://www.eltiempo.com/politica/gobierno/presidente-duque-en-alocucion-sobre-el-atentado-en-bogota-del-eln-316316 (''El Tiempo'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/18/world/americas/atentado-bogota-colombia-bombing-eln.html (''The New York Times'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Tlahuelilpan pipeline explosion]]
**An illicitly tapped fuel pipeline explodes in [[Tlahuelilpan]], [[Hidalgo (state)|Hidalgo]], [[Mexico]], killing at least 109 people and wounding 46 others. It is believed the explosion occurred after the line was ruptured by suspected fuel thieves. [http://www.milenio.com/estados/sube-109-cifra-muertos-explosion-hidalgo (Milenio)] 
;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**The [[Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese government]] rejects a request by the [[African Union]] to delay the announcement of the final result of the 30 December 2018 general election, which is being appealed in the country's [[Constitutional Court of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Constitutional Court]] amidst accusations of election fraud. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2019/01/dr-congo-slams-african-union-call-suspend-election-result-190118140840583.html (Al Jazeera)]
